Share of hours in and around the comfort zone

Source: R/fct_plots.R
comfort_summary.Rd

Pairs the hourly averages of temperature and humidity by hour and counts how many hours fall inside the comfortable ranges, and how many are too warm, too cool, too dry or too humid (an hour can be both too warm and too dry).

Usage

comfort_summary(
  temperature,
  humidity,
  temperature_range = c(20, 25),
  humidity_range = c(40, 60)
)

Arguments

temperature, humidity

Data frames from get_hourly() of temperature and humidity.

temperature_range, humidity_range

The comfortable ranges, the same as the green bands of the Current tab: 20 to 25 degrees Celsius and 40 to 60%.

Value

A list: hours, the number of hours with both readings, and the percentages comfortable, too_warm, too_cool, too_dry and too_humid.

Examples

hours <- expand.grid(hour = 0:23, date = as.Date("2026-10-01") + 0:6)
temperature <- transform(hours, value = 22 + 4 * sin((hour - 9) / 24 * 2 * pi))
humidity <- transform(hours, value = 45 - 8 * sin((hour - 9) / 24 * 2 * pi))
comfort_summary(temperature, humidity)
#> $hours
#> [1] 168
#> 
#> $comfortable
#> [1] 41.66667
#> 
#> $too_warm
#> [1] 20.83333
#> 
#> $too_cool
#> [1] 29.16667
#> 
#> $too_dry
#> [1] 29.16667
#> 
#> $too_humid
#> [1] 0
#>
